episodes.title: Love at First Sight
episodes.summary: Ming and Joe meet on a filming set and quickly begin to form a connection.

episodes.title: Ambiguous
episodes.summary: Ming experiences some jealousy over Joe when his friend Sol returns from Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tong's reliance on his stand-in provides Joe with an unexpected opportunity to showcase his acting talents.

episodes.title: If Miracle Doesn't Come
episodes.summary: Ming takes a severe action to help Tong not be replaced in his upcoming film.

episodes.title: Second Chance
episodes.summary: Joe's mother's debt pushes him back into the world of stunt performance.

episodes.title: The Most Familiar Stranger
episodes.summary: Sol and Ming both offer Joe a way out of his financial problems.

episodes.title: Hug
episodes.summary: Joe begins his new arrangement with Ming, but jealousy quickly flairs during Sol's music video production.  As filming begins for Joe and Tong's next project, Ming makes a discovery about Joe and Tong's past.

episodes.title: When False is Taken for True, True Becomes False
episodes.summary: As too many coincidences emerge, those close to Joe become suspicious about his real identity.

episodes.title: Among Thousands of People You Meet Those You've Met
episodes.summary: Joe, Wut, Sol, and Ming investigate the discovery of Joe's remains.

episodes.title: Had I not seen the sun, I could have borne the shade
episodes.summary: Tong is in desperate need of money but Ming is no longer willing to support him.

episodes.title: Love is Merely a Madness
episodes.summary: Ming's father offers him an ultimatum regarding his relationship with Joe.

episodes.title: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
episodes.summary: Joe is faced with a final choice to return or start over.
